notes.title: Kittenship Care Demo Now Live & Release Date Announced!
notes.notes: [p]Hey everyone![/p][p][/p][p]We’re so excited to finally share the [i]Kittenship Care[/i] [b]demo[/b] with you! Starting today, you can jump in and get a first taste of what it’s like to foster rescue kittens, build trust, and create a cozy, personalized space for your furry guests.[/p][p][/p][p]Even more exciting,  we’re thrilled to announce that [i]Kittenship Care[/i] will officially launch on [b]August 8th[/b]![/p][p][/p][p]This demo gives you a peek into the heart of the game:[/p][list][*][p]Bond with quirky kittens[/p][/*][*][p]Clean up tiny messes[/p][/*][*][p]Decorate your space to suit your furry friends[/p][/*][*][p]And get them ready to find their forever homes[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]We’d [i]love[/i] to hear what you think! Feel free to leave feedback, share your favorite moments, or even tell us about your own foster/adoption stories.[/p][p][/p][p]Thanks so much for all the love and support so far. This game means the world to us, and we’re so happy you’re here with us on the journey.[/p][p][/p][p]See you August 8th![/p][p]– The [i]Kittenship Care[/i] Team 🐾[/p]
